body: From the pre-registered US solvency test (4,821 firm-snapshots, 2015/17/19; survivorship-free via EDGAR): S1 lift 2.31 (excludes 3.7% of >3x winners), S5 lift 2.37 (8.0%) pass as graded red; none reaches the 4x hard bar; recall low (S1 8%, S5 16% of failures); not a short signal. Re-test needed on Indian data (IBBI admissions, delistings; NBFC ALM; lower interest-cover norms).
title: Solvency: S1 negative equity (buyback-exempt) and S5 ≥2 flags = graded red; S2/S3/S4 = deep-dive questions
